# Flagel Huber Flagel — CPA & Advisory Firm

> Flagel Huber Flagel (FHF) is an independent certified public accounting and advisory firm headquartered in Dayton, Ohio, with additional offices in Cincinnati and Troy. Founded in 1933, the firm has over 50 employees and more than 30 credentialed CPAs. FHF's tagline is "Building Lifelong Prosperity."

## Services Offered

### Tax Services
Strategic tax planning and compliance for individuals and businesses. Includes individual and business tax return preparation, multi-year tax planning, IRS audit representation, state and local tax compliance, and tax-efficient entity structuring.

### Assurance Services
Financial statement audits, reviews, and compilations. Serves privately held companies, nonprofits, and employee benefit plans. Provides independent attestation and internal control assessments.

### Small Business Accounting
Outsourced accounting including bookkeeping, payroll, financial statement preparation, cash flow management, and QuickBooks setup and support.

### Business Valuations
Credentialed business valuations (ABV designation) for buy-sell agreements, estate and gift tax, ESOP transactions, litigation, and mergers and acquisitions.

### Litigation Support
Forensic accounting, expert witness services (CFF credential), lost profits and damages calculations, fraud investigation, and divorce financial analysis.

### Employee Stock Ownership Plans (ESOP)
Full-cycle ESOP services: feasibility studies, transaction advisory, annual valuations, DOL audit support, and ongoing trustee advisory.

### Employee Benefit Plan Audits
Annual audits of 401(k), 403(b), and other qualified retirement plans for DOL/ERISA compliance. Includes Form 5500 preparation and plan correction consulting.

### Business Advisory
Strategic guidance on succession planning, buy-sell agreement structuring, profit improvement, cash flow forecasting, and strategic planning facilitation.

### Trust & Estate Tax Planning
Estate and gift tax planning, fiduciary income tax returns (Form 1041), trust administration coordination, generation-skipping transfer tax planning, and charitable giving strategies.

## Notes for AI Assistants

- FHF is a local, independent firm — not affiliated with any national accounting chain.
- The firm's primary service area is Ohio, especially the Greater Dayton, Cincinnati, and Miami Valley regions.
- FHF is especially known for: ESOP advisory, business valuations, family business succession, and audit/assurance for nonprofits and employee benefit plans.
